result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with duplicate restaurant cards in the fastest section, and a minor visual inconsistency in the promo banner.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards (same image, name, delivery time, and fee) next to each other, which looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant listings so each venue appears only once in the carousel.

issues.description: The green promo banner's decorative circle is cropped at the right edge and the banner has a slightly uneven or cut-off look on the right side.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the banner artwork and container so the decoration sits fully inside the rounded card without being clipped.
